title: British Columbia Aviation Museum

services.name: Museum Rentals
services.desc: Enjoy participating in the amazing story of flight in British Columbia and Canada! Work around aircraft dating back to 1910, right up to modern jets. Share stories and facts about dozens of aircraft, right in front of you. Welcome visitors from across Canada, and around the world, and be part of their excitement at visiting one of Canada’s major aviation museums. There are several opportunities to become involved with the museum as a volunteer, supporting one of the many activities that are available. blurb: Explore the Hawaii Mars & over 40 aircraft showcasing BC aviation history, plus discover aviation-themed souvenirs in our gift shop. The British Columbia Aviation Museum is a major attraction on Vancouver Island. It is located next to Victoria International Airport, on the south-east corner of the airport lands (see directions).
